How It Works

The Backdrop Bar

We're a Bay Area backdrop and prop rental company that takes the stress out of event decorating. You pick what you love, we handle delivery, setup, and pickup so you can actually enjoy your event.

Our collection includes flower walls, arch panels, neon signs, marquee numbers, letters, and more, with new pieces added regularly. Whether you're planning a wedding, baby shower, birthday, or any celebration worth remembering, we have something that fits.

We deliver across the Bay Area, from San Jose and San Francisco to Oakland and everywhere in between.

1
Browse

Explore our curated collection of backdrops, neon signs, and props.

2
Reserve

Select your date and complete your booking in minutes.

3
Receive

We deliver and set up throughout the Bay Area.

4
Return

We collect everything after — you just enjoy the moment.

What's Included With Every Rental

Delivery to your venue
